title: Helpdesk: No Experience to Tier 2
description: A practical, 6-month, 60-lesson course that takes a complete beginner with no PC experience to a job-ready IT Helpdesk Tier 1/2 technician. Built around CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft MD-102 and MS-102, with hands-on labs and modern AI tools for endpoint support.
audience: Career changers and beginners with little or no PC experience aiming for a first IT support / helpdesk role.

moduleTitles.1: PC Hardware & How Computers Work (A+ Core 1)
moduleTitles.4: The Helpdesk Professional: ITIL, Ticketing & Soft Skills
